subject: gov.legislate
name: ICT Authority
milestone: The ministry briefed the President on establishing the body while awaiting the passage of legislation
position_end: Being established as a state entity under the ICT ministry while legislation is awaited (2026-08)
note: A May 2026 account states the President signed the Authority's legal framework; an August 2026 account states the government is establishing it while awaiting legislation. The two have not been reconciled, and the division of competence with the National Communication Authority is unstated. Reconcile attempt 1, 2026-08-09: no bill, act, presidential order or gazette entry can be found. The MoJCA law collection's most recent instrument is the Labour Act 2017 and it omits the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026 too; the Office of the President's decrees page publishes no documents; the TNLA bills register stops in August 2023. The registers are not current enough for their silence to settle anything. Reconcile attempt 2, 2026-08-10, closed unresolved: both accounts trace to one speaker, the ICT minister, who on 2026-05-21 said the law is out already and signed by the president and on 2026-08-05 was reported standing the body up while parliament legislation is awaited. No instrument is retrievable because South Sudan has no operating gazette: on 2026-01-12 the President ordered a committee to launch the Official Gazette and clear a publication backlog of every law and decree since 2011, and no maiden edition is on file; signed presidential documents are classed privileged executive communication barred from being photographed, scanned or shared online. The Assembly publishes no Hansard - nla.gov.ss 404s on /hansard, /hansards and /documents and its bills and order-of-the-day pages are procedural explainers, not registers. The qualified status is the resting state and the brief is closed.

Reconcile attempt 1, 2026-08-09: no construction record exists in any reachable published source — the NCA's publications page carries five documents and none concerns the data centre, its news feed carries nothing on the build or on the oversight committee's output, the ICT ministry publishes nothing after 2025-12-18, and MGI Communications has made no statement. The absence is stated dated on the hub. Reconcile attempt 2, 2026-08-10, closed unresolved: the World Bank EARDIP project P176181, the only Bank digital operation covering South Sudan, carries no data-centre workstream in its ISR of 2026-06-30 and the Bank archive returns nothing on the facility, so it is not donor-financed and no procurement record exists where one normally would; mgi communications ag is a privately held Swiss company of about nine people in Zug and files no public accounts. That ISR does establish dated that guidelines on government data hosting including cloud adoption were still unpublished at 2026-06-16, unchanged from the 2022-11 baseline against an 2028-04 target. It is also not established that there is only one facility: the regulator in 2026-01 describes MGI in the present tense as managing critical data centre infrastructure, while the minister in 2026-04 describes a centre being built and halfway complete. The dated stand-off is the resting state and the brief is closed.
